name: Polo
notes: Early Age of Machinery, around or shortly after Year 2,200. Polo compares inherited tide and seasonal observations with newer instruments. The reform programme makes common standards useful to navigation and agriculture while preserving observations specific to each place. The University register proposes a connection to Narmada Compares Shadow Tables with Telegraph Time and Pragjyotisha Adopts the Twin Reckoning. The capacity and timing depend on the event testimony.
sources: Author’s revised Early Age of Machinery placement and political roles, 2026-11-24.
